title: Accounts Receivable Note: Nights Collected in Advance on a Respite or Trial Stay
content:
The nights collected in the advance on a booked stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement depend on the payment history of the stay and of the guest's Larkspur independent living account.

**Rule.** The advance nights are all planned nights when the stay shows a returned payment and its planned nights exceed the minimum stay; the minimum stay plus three nights (3 nights) when the stay shows no returned payment and the guest's Larkspur independent living account shows a returned payment posted in the last twelve months (12 months); and the minimum stay of the stay type otherwise.

**Terms.**
- The planned nights are the planned departure date less the planned arrival date recorded on the stay.
- "The stay shows a returned payment" means the stay's own ledger carries at least one returned-payment entry.
- The guest's Larkspur independent living account is the account of the guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement; its returned-payment entries posted in the last twelve months are counted.

## Truth table

| Returned payment on the stay | Planned nights exceed the minimum stay | Returned payment on the independent living account in the last 12 months | Advance nights |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Any | All planned nights |
| Yes | No | Any | The minimum stay |
| No | Any | Yes | The minimum stay plus 3 nights |
| No | Any | No | The minimum stay |

## Hypothetical illustrations (Assisted Living Respite Stay, minimum stay 7 nights)

- 21 planned nights; one payment on the stay was returned: 21 advance nights.
- 21 planned nights; no return on the stay; one returned payment on the independent living account four months ago: 7 plus 3, that is 10 advance nights.
- 7 planned nights; one payment on the stay was returned: planned nights do not exceed the minimum stay, so 7 advance nights.
- 14 planned nights; no returned payment anywhere: 7 advance nights.
